# Third-party material

`domainbed/algorithms.py` is the unmodified DomainBed algorithms file at commit `b93c22a1cfc3b2428398272c1a116c8de1f4139e`:

https://github.com/facebookresearch/DomainBed/blob/b93c22a1cfc3b2428398272c1a116c8de1f4139e/domainbed/algorithms.py

Its MIT license is retained in `domainbed/LICENSE`. The comparator extracts the mean/covariance discrepancy from `AbstractMMD.mmd` through Python's AST. The local tabular network and sampling scheme are described in `METHODS.md`.

Dataset attribution and license links are listed in `DATA.md`.
